dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あと２日で授業も終わりだけど、その後の卒
　業パーティーの準備も、しっかり手伝うんだ
　よ」
dialogues.en:
"Just two more days to the end of classes. Be sure to help
out with the graduation party preparations after that."
dialogues.text:
"Just two more days to the end of classes. Be sure to help
out with the graduation party preparations after that."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生の合図を受けて、田端が号令をだす。
dialogues.en:
At Koyomi's signal, Tahata gave the order for the class to
bow goodbye.
dialogues.text:
At Koyomi's signal, Tahata gave the order for the class to
bow goodbye.

dialogues.jp: そうか……来週で卒業なんだな。
dialogues.en: That's right... next week is graduation week.
dialogues.text: That's right... next week is graduation week.

dialogues.jp: ちょっとだけ、感傷的な気分に浸ってみる。
dialogues.en:
Even I was getting a bit caught up in the sentimentality of
it all now.
dialogues.text:
Even I was getting a bit caught up in the sentimentality of
it all now.

dialogues.jp:
（まあ、校舎が変わるだけだから、どうってこ
　とないんだがな……）
dialogues.en:
"(It'd probably be worse if I actually had to change
schools...)"
dialogues.text:
"(It'd probably be worse if I actually had to change
schools...)"

dialogues.jp: 島の外にでも出ない限り、また会うことになる。
dialogues.en:
As long as I can't leave this island, I'd surely come back
to here again.
dialogues.text:
As long as I can't leave this island, I'd surely come back
to here again.

dialogues.jp: 「んな先のことよりも、今日のことを考えよう」
dialogues.en:
"Well, that's something for the future. Now, to think about
today."
dialogues.text:
"Well, that's something for the future. Now, to think about
today."

dialogues.jp: 俺は帰り支度をしながら、何をしようか考える。
dialogues.en: As I prepare to go home, I think about what to do.
dialogues.text: As I prepare to go home, I think about what to do.

dialogues.jp:
田端の号令でＨＲが終った。今週末から、卒パ
準備期間、そしてそれが終ればとうとう卒業か。
dialogues.en:
At Tahata's order, HR ended. Starting from this weekend
would be the graduation party preparation period, then after
that the graduation itself.
dialogues.text:
At Tahata's order, HR ended. Starting from this weekend
would be the graduation party preparation period, then after
that the graduation itself.

dialogues.jp: まあ、それよりはまず、今日何するかだよな。
dialogues.en: Anyway, putting that aside, what should I do today.
dialogues.text: Anyway, putting that aside, what should I do today.
